title: Tunnelling in Quantum Cosmology: WKB vs SWKB
summary: This study analyses WKB and Supersymmetric WKB (SWKB) methods in a closed Friedmann-Robertson-Walker (FRW) minisuperspace model to determine whether they yield different results in modelling tunnelling phenomena in quantum cosmology. The transition from a dust-dominated to a dark-energy-dominated epoch driven by a generalised Chaplygin gas is examined. Incorporating supersymmetric quantum mechanics requires modifying the initial potential, influencing late-time evolution: after the dust-dominated phase, the universe enters a dark-energy regime that decays back into a dust-dominated period.…
